title: Serendipity Arts Festival returns to Panjim from 13 to 20 December, free to attend
dek: The 11th edition of the multidisciplinary festival in Goa covers visual arts, craft, music, dance, theatre and food, each strand led by named curators.
body: The Serendipity Arts Festival will hold its 11th edition in Panjim, Goa, from 13 to 20 December 2026, across several venues in the city. It is organised by the not-for-profit Serendipity Arts Foundation, and entry is free.

The festival has named its curators by discipline. Visual arts: the art historian Latika Gupta and the artist Sheba Chhachhi. Craft: Kshitij Jalori and Sudheer Rajbhar. Music: the Carnatic vocalist Aruna Sairam and the singer-songwriter Ankur Tewari. Dance: Ashley Lobo and Surjit Nongmeikapam. Theatre: Mahesh Dattani and Anuradha Kapur. Culinary arts: Anisha Rachel Oommen. Accessibility: Salil Chaturvedi. Special projects: Sreyansi Singh and Padmini Chettur.

The festival director, Smriti Rajgarhia, has said the 2026 curators were brought together to deepen dialogue between disciplines. Homegrown's festival guide, published on 11 November, lists performances including a sitar symphony by Ravi Chary, a tribute by Trilok Gurtu to Shobha Gurtu, and the dance works Prime by Avantika Bahl and Rubber Girl by Preethi Athreya.
